app_user: External identity mapping and application account flags.
project: Top-level construction project, ownership and archive state.
project_user: One retained row for each user and project pair.
drawing: Validated immutable PDF metadata; bytes live in object storage.
drawing_page: One row per PDF page, with normalized-coordinate reference dimensions.
punch_item: Deficiency details, immutable page anchor, current assignment and workflow state.
photo: Metadata for images attached to punch items.
markup: Validated annotations on a drawing page, optionally linked to an item.
export_job: Queued project export requests and verified output metadata.
punch_item_event: Append-only records of item creation, status, assignment and revision changes.
schema_migration: Technical record of applied database migrations.

rules.app_user: PK user_id. Unique (auth_issuer, auth_subject); a partial lower(email) unique index applies to non-NULL email. Runtime roles cannot change accounts or read authentication identifiers.
rules.project: PK project_id. created_by references app_user. create_project creates the project and its first administrator in one transaction. Runtime hard deletion is not granted.
rules.project_user: PK project_user_id. Unique (project_id, user_id); foreign keys reference project and app_user. Membership changes use set_project_member, which retains an active administrator and rejects deactivation while assignments remain.
rules.drawing: PK drawing_id. Unique (project_id, drawing_id) and storage_ref. (project_id, uploaded_by) references project_user. The storage key is projects/{project_id}/drawings/{drawing_id}/source.pdf. Runtime records are insert-only.
rules.drawing_page: Composite PK (project_id, drawing_id, page_number) references the corresponding drawing. A range trigger prevents pages beyond page_count, and deferred constraint triggers require exactly page_count rows at commit. Runtime metadata is insert-only.
rules.punch_item: PK punch_item_id. Composite foreign keys reference drawing_page and project_user for creator and assignee. Unique (project_id, punch_item_id) and (project_id, drawing_id, page_number, punch_item_id) support evidence associations. The anchor and authorship cannot be changed by the runtime.
rules.comment: PK comment_id. (project_id, punch_item_id) references punch_item and (project_id, author_user_id) references project_user. Runtime edits can change only body, and require the author or an administrator.
rules.photo: PK photo_id; storage_ref is unique. Composite foreign keys reference punch_item and project_user. The object key is projects/{project_id}/photos/{photo_id}/original. Runtime rows are insert-only.
rules.markup: PK markup_id. A page FK always applies. The optional four-column item FK requires the same project, drawing and page when punch_item_id is present. Author references project_user. Runtime edits change only type and geometry.
rules.export_job: PK export_id; storage_ref is unique when present. Project and requester must match project membership. State-dependent checks require complete output metadata on success, a nonblank error on failure, and ordered timestamps. Only approved functions mutate jobs.
rules.punch_item_event: PK event_id. Composite foreign keys reference the item, actor and old/new assignee memberships. Runtime roles can only read visible project events. History is a change ledger, not a complete snapshot of every old field value.
rules.schema_migration: PK version. Applied by the migration owner; runtime roles have no access. Initial package versions are 1 and 2.
